Estimate free drinking intake of lactating dairy cows.

Source: R/livestock_water.R
estimate_dairy_drinking.Rd

Apply the empirical lactating-cow model of Cardot, Le Roux and Jurjanz (2008), doi:10.3168/jds.2007-0204. "cardot_table5" uses the body equation and Table 5 coefficients (DMI 1.54; minimum temperature 0.58). "cardot_abstract" explicitly selects the differing abstract coefficients (1.53 and 0.57). Other coefficients are identical. The fit used 1,837 cow-days from 41 mid-lactation Holstein cows during three winters in a free-stall, corn-silage/concentrate TMR setting (summer grazing excluded). R-squared was 0.446. Checking marginal predictor ranges does not establish validity for other breeds, diets, climates or joint conditions.

"legacy_adult" selects the 55 L/day mixed-system dairy drinking demand in Chapagain and Hoekstra (2003), Value of Water Research Report 13, Table 3.8 (https://waterfootprint.org/resources/Report13.pdf): mean of industrial 70 and grazing 40 L/day. Its adult lactation assumption is a sensitivity, not an observed population coefficient. Neither method includes service water, leakage or net consumption. Existing generated rate, quantity and method columns are rejected rather than overwritten; supply the original predictor/exposure columns.

Usage

estimate_dairy_drinking(
  data,
  method = c("cardot_table5", "cardot_abstract", "legacy_adult"),
  extrapolation = c("abort", "allow")
)

Arguments

data

Tibble with animal_days, item_cbs_code (960), cohort ("lactating"), and production_system. Cardot methods require production_system = "free_stall_tmr", dry_matter_intake_kg_day, milk_kg_day, diet_dry_matter_percent, minimum_temperature_c, and rainfall_mm_day. Additional identity/source columns are retained.

method

Select "cardot_table5" (default), "cardot_abstract", or "legacy_adult". There is no fallback between methods.

extrapolation

"abort" (default) rejects predictors outside the marginal ranges in Table 4. "allow" warns and marks such rows. Impossible negative predictions always abort, never clamp to zero.

Value

Input rows with drinking_l_day, drinking_m3, method_drinking_water, quantity_basis, water_extrapolated, and drinking_rate_source / drinking_rate_basis provenance.

Examples

# Published rounded means/exposure, not raw individual cow-day records.
x <- tibble::tibble(
  animal_days = 1837, item_cbs_code = 960L, cohort = "lactating",
  production_system = "free_stall_tmr", dry_matter_intake_kg_day = 20.6,
  milk_kg_day = 26.5, diet_dry_matter_percent = 48.1,
  minimum_temperature_c = 0.1, rainfall_mm_day = 1.3,
  rate_id = "study_means", assessment_period = "2003–2005 winter trials",
  exposure_source = "Cardot 2008 Tables 1 and 3",
  exposure_basis = "observed cow-days"
)
intake <- estimate_dairy_drinking(x)
rates <- intake |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    rate_id, item_cbs_code, cohort, production_system, drinking_l_day,
    service_l_day = NA_real_, quantity_basis,
    rate_source = drinking_rate_source, rate_basis = drinking_rate_basis
  )
calculate_livestock_water(x, rates)

#>   animal_days item_cbs_code cohort    production_system dry_matter_intake_kg_day
